records.instrument: Replacement Cost New (RCN) construction rate table
records.currencyNote: Assumed new-build construction cost used for the cost approach. Depreciated by age band.

valuation.basisNote: A decision-support guide positioned for a selling or buying decision. It is not a statutory assessment, tax determination, or lending valuation.
valuation.valuationDateRule: The valuation date is the date the guide is generated. Reference-rate effectivity is tracked separately as provenance and is not treated as the valuation date.
intendedUsers: Brokers qualifying an enquiry before a site visit
valuation.standardOfCare: Automated valuation model with disclosed, deterministic and reconcilable inputs. Every peso in the output traces to a documented reference rate or a stated factor.

market.label: Market approach (adjusted reference rate)
market.usedFor: Land value for all property types
market.description: The official BIR zonal rate for the matched street and classification is adjusted by disclosed market factors to produce an effective land rate per square metre. Area is then applied.

cost.label: Cost approach (replacement cost new less depreciation)
cost.description: Construction cost per square metre is applied to floor area, adjusted for storeys, then depreciated by age band. Vacant lots carry no improvement component.

evidence.label: Market evidence display
evidence.description: Comparable asking listings are retrieved and shown for orientation. Asking prices are not direct inputs to the calculated figure.

order: BIR zonal rate per sqm for matched street and classification
adjustmentFramework.note: Factors compose multiplicatively. The build-up is displayed in full so the arithmetic can be checked by the reader.

factors.label: BIR zonal base rate
factors.disclosure: Per sqm, per street and classification

factors.label: Corner lot adjustment
factors.disclosure: Applied only when a corner influence is recorded

factors.label: Market band midpoint
factors.disclosure: Multiplier for the central estimate; the separate scenario policy sets the displayed range

factors.label: Regional adjustment
factors.disclosure: Held at 1.00 for current Batangas coverage; reserved for future regional differentiation

factors.label: Lot area
factors.disclosure: User-supplied; effective rate multiplied by area

construction.label: RCN rates (house and lot)
construction.unit: PHP per sqm of floor area

range.method: 85% and 130% of the calculated central planning estimate
range.meaning: The range is an asymmetric planning scenario envelope, not a statistical confidence interval or an accuracy score. Source match depth is reported separately and does not set its width.
range.guidance: Use the central estimate and scenario endpoints as reference points, not guaranteed buyer offers or a prescribed walk-away price.

assurance.statement: Land value, improvement value and the stated total reconcile arithmetically on every run.
Identical numeric inputs and explicit indexing dates reproduce the same arithmetic; current verification status is tracked separately.
Every reference rate resolves to a named BIR instrument, RDO, classification and effectivity date.

Where a street has no listed rate for the classification, the fallback chain is used and disclosed in the result. Masked 'same as above' rows are resolved only where a municipality-wide rate exists; they are never guessed.
Data version and calculation version are stamped on every output and advance on any change to the dataset or engine.
Scheduled review dates are reminders, not proof of successful applicability verification. Attempted and successful checks are recorded separately.

limitations: No physical inspection of the property is performed or implied.
Interior condition, structural defects and unpermitted additions are not observed; recorded condition inputs are unverified.
Comparable listings are asking-price context, not verified transaction records.
The factor set is a SEA ESTATES internal reference and has not been reviewed by an independent qualified appraiser.
Occupancy, title, inheritance, flood and access are unverified review conditions. No unsupported flat risk deductions are applied to the neutral planning estimate.

taxContext.note: Tax illustrations use entered/assumed price and imported schedule values where matched. Latest applicability and statutory FMV require confirmation; assessed value is not full assessor-schedule FMV. Indexed scenarios never replace official tax references.

customerSummary: Every figure traces to a published BIR zonal rate or a factor shown on screen.
The arithmetic is displayed in full so you can check it yourself.
The BIR rate is a tax reference and is reported separately from the estimate.
Where data is missing the fallback used is stated rather than hidden.
This is a decision-support guide; a site inspection refines it.
